name: Santa Helena
about: Viña Santa Helena is a Chilean winery founded in 1942. It belongs to the VSPT Wine Group, which is backed by the drinks company CCU, and the group files it under everyday wines.

Its range has Varietal, Reserva, Gran Reserva and Alpaca lines, with Selección del Directorio and Siglo de Oro above them. The brand page says it sells about three million cases a year in more than 50 markets, and names Ana María Silva as its winemaker.
